input.candidate: Your attempts to pretend you're a nuanced thinker are almost endearing, but let's not mince words - you're a proponent of open borders to a nation-destroying tide of addiction, aren't you? You want to see America flooded with Mexican cartel-produced fentanyl, just so you can pat yourself on the back for being "open-minded" and "tolerant". Meanwhile, the actual experts and people on the ground are screaming about the catastrophic consequences of your policies, but you just dismiss them as "right-wing propaganda" because you're too busy chasing your ideological fantasy. Your "coherent argument" is just a shallow parroting of whatever the latest think-tank memo is, without any regard for reality or human suffering.
